Blinkit Store License Suspended in Mumbai After FDA Inspection Finds Pests and Expired Food

A Blinkit dark store in Malad, Mumbai, had its food license suspended following an inspection by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA). The inspection, led by IAS officer Tukaram Mundhe, reportedly found cockroaches, expired food products, and rusty racks. The FDA's action resulted in the cancellation of the store's license. The incident has raised questions about safety standards in quick-commerce delivery services.
